route: Elective residence visa (residenza elettiva) for people of independent means. Health rule is set per consulate. Paris: "An international medical insurance covering the entire stay with a minimum of 30.000 € coverage and full and unlimited coverage for hospitalization. Emergency repatriation flight ... must be included." After arrival the ASL notice says foreigners staying over three months who are bound to insure themselves can do so "mediante la stipula di una polizza assicurativa privata, ovvero, con l'iscrizione volontaria al SSN" and lists RESIDENZA ELETTIVA among the permits allowing voluntary enrolment.
policy: Voluntary enrolment in the Servizio Sanitario Nazionale (iscrizione volontaria). It is income-based with a floor: 7.5% of household income up to EUR 20,658.28 plus 4% of income between EUR 20,658.28 and EUR 51,645.69, never below EUR 2,000 a year, and capped by the formula at EUR 2,788.87 once income reaches EUR 51,645.69. The ASL notice calls the base 'reddito complessivo (nucleo fiscale)'. The figure here is that ceiling, which applies to the target household (withdrawals of EUR 60,000 to 150,000), taken as one household payment covering both spouses. Visa stage still needs a private policy (first months or year).
working: 7.5% x 20,658.28 = 1,549.37. 4% x (51,645.69 - 20,658.28 = 30,987.41) = 1,239.50. Sum = 2,788.87 EUR a year, / 12 = 232.41 EUR a month for the household. Floor case (low declared Italian income): 2,000 / 12 = 166.67 a month. If each spouse had to pay separately the ceiling doubles to 464.81 a month.

eu_citizen_difference: Not researched: no source on the EU-citizen position was retrieved. The elective-residence visa itself does not apply to EU citizens, who register as residents instead.
spot_check: italyhandbook.com computes the same ceiling (EUR 2,788.87 a year). The Constitutional Court judgment 97/2026 of 5 June 2026 concerns elective-residence holders who become disabled; it was not read in full and does not change the ordinary contribution.
uncertainty: (1) No private-policy price for two 45-year-olds was found: the web search budget ran out and no insurer tariff for the Italian visa market was reachable. The only price seen is Feather's 'from €72 per month' (one person, age unstated). A mid-range guess from comparison sites (not used) was EUR 140 to 185 per person per month. (2) Whether the SSN contribution is one per household or one per spouse: the notice says 'nucleo fiscale' but the Ministry text was not read, so the couple could pay up to double (464.81 a month). (3) Whether capital gains from an ETF portfolio form part of 'reddito complessivo'. (4) Enrolment is by calendar year, so the first year may double up with private cover. (5) Other consulates require different cover wording.
